notes.title: Update 60: Release Notes
notes.content:
First off, we’ve added an [b]in-game chat feature,[/b] making it easier for you to communicate with other players while playing. Whether coordinating strategies or just having a friendly conversation, this will enhance your multiplayer experience.

A new addition is that [b]NPCs can now be created in multiplayer! [/b]This is the first step toward making the world feel more alive during multiplayer sessions.

We’ve also expanded the game world with [b]more buildings and cars,[/b] adding new layers of depth and realism to your environment. On top of that, there have been several [b]UI improvements[/b] aimed at making the interface smoother and more intuitive for players.

For those of you who love multiplayer, we’ve made a lot of [b]stability improvements[/b] to ensure a more reliable and seamless experience during your sessions. Additionally, there have been major [b]pathfinding improvements[/b], making character and vehicle movement more fluid and intelligent.

Finally, we’ve tackled a lot of other [b]bug fixes[/b] to ensure a smoother overall gameplay experience. And last but not least, [b]Mac users can finally play too![/b]

Thanks for your continued support, and we can’t wait to see you in-game! 😎 

Bitmagic Team

notes.title: Update 58: Release Notes
notes.content:
We’re happy to introduce the first version of our new game mode, [b]Co-Prompting![/b] Now you can join a game and collaborate with others on prompts, adding a fresh layer of fun to the experience. Along with this, we’ve revamped the in-game HUD to enhance your overall gameplay.

In multiplayer, cars and animals are now fully functional, bringing more depth and excitement to your sessions. We’ve also addressed various bugs to ensure smoother performance across the board.

Please note that the game creation and “My Games” view are disabled for time being as we focus our efforts on refining Co-Prompting. For Mac users, this update is slightly delayed, but we’ll keep you updated on its availability.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the latest features! 

Bitmagic Team

notes.title: Multiplayer in Bitmagic?
notes.content:
[h3]Multiplayer![/h3]

[b]Hello hello![/b]

Part of game creation is deciding whether the game will be a single-player experience or multiplayer. Now, we couldn’t rightly put Bitmagic out there for tons of burgeoning game creators if we didn’t include multiplayer, could we? 

So, Bitmagic will be launching into Early Access with multiplayer. 

You can create games that allow players to play together in your creations. Novel idea, I know! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/72d5a9b7b274a7793411be39c50178de873e9dbb.jpg[/img]

Jokes aside, Bitmagic as a platform will allow for both single-player game creation and play as well as multiplayer. 

If you just want to create a game for you and your friends to hang out in, you can. Maybe you release it to the community to test their skills or simply create a game for a deep journey of adventure and exploration. 

Bitmagic has you covered.

[b]-JB[/b]

notes.title: Bitmagic & Discord!
notes.content:
[h3]Next stop, Discord.[/h3]

[b]Hello hello![/b]

Our community continues to grow, and those in the community are currently playing the Pre-alpha of Bitmagic. With each update, they get to test out all the new goodies and provide us with their feedback. From game ideas to character additions, events and changes… even mini-games. The community has been active and alive, a real part of the development of Bitmagic. 

At the moment, we are working on the multiplayer component of Bitmagic. Each week, we host a multiplayer test for which the community votes; they can submit their games for all to play, and even the developers jump in!  Which leads me to…

If you would like to join in on testing, jump on our Discord and shout out to the team. That’s all it takes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/400404ab605e4b7d66ddf22123efde125a588157.jpg[/img]

Outside of the multiplayer, if you join Discord, you can jump right on into Bitmagic and begin creating your very own games right away.

If you have any questions, you can ask the community, mods and the developers. Want people to play your games outside of the weekly test, hell, organise your own test amongst the community, creating your own player base to enjoy games with together.

There is no reason to not join our Discord, so go ahead, click the link and become a Creator!

[b]-JB[/b]

notes.title: AI AI Captain!
notes.content:
[h3]Setting sail on the seas of GenAI![/h3]

[b]Hello hello![/b]

[i]Today, I come bearing tech news.[/i]

[b]More advancements have been made to our AI database. [/b]

The team have been working with it to make Bitmagic sharper. Quicker prompting times, smarter asset loading, and better interpretations of your prompts.

The AI is there to help aid you in building your very own games; it takes most of the heavy lifting out of game creation and allows you a lot to do what you do best. Imagine games.

What Bitmagics AI should do is clear the red tape for you all, and present you from first prompt a game you can be proud of. But of course, the prompt is not the only thing it does. Far from it! 

When you are in your game, Bitmagic AI is there alongside you, giving you the tools to develop your game further, allowing you to add some of the above-mentioned to fill out your game to a personal level. Allowing you to add your signature flair to what you create!

While AI is not new to gaming, it has been widely used for years now(did I just break kayfabe?); the way Bitmagic is utilising AI is brand new.

As soon as Bitmagic boots, you should be greeted with your opening salvo into creating your very own game, the first prompt screen, with all your saved games.

As soon as you enter your first game creation prompt, Bitmagic’s AI takes over and builds that game in seconds before your eyes.

From there, you are free to begin prompting and altering to reveal the game you always wanted to play and make.

But obviously, it doesn’t end there; simply save and share it to give your creation to the community.

Or, if you want to be selfish, you can keep your game all to yourself!

[i]Again, I will be back with more news to keep your beaks wet. Until then…[/i]

[b]-JB[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/396949bdf004f55b17f91336e8a3e2d4e6cbef11.jpg[/img]

notes.title: FX of all kinds and NPC's!
notes.content:
[h1][i]Two bits of news for the price of none. [/i][/h1]

[b]Hello hello![/b]

[b]We have had some amazing advancements with enemy types and their behaviours.[/b]

Now, we know the best sorts of enemies are those you see driven before you, but what about those enemies that shamble, that run, that hunt you down? 

Maybe you don’t want enemies but tiny little NPCs or just some random pedestrians. We got em. 

We have options for those of you who want to populate your games with the sorts of NPCs you want. Ranging from brain-eating zombies to average Joe citizens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/d9b140dff9e5f882f890d4555576b8988b8f5066.jpg[/img]

[b]In the FX department we have some great news also![/b]

We recently welcomed a brand new member to the team here at Bitmagic, and oh boy, are they awesome! 

Ari is our Tech Artist, and he is doing some amazing work! His main goal for you Creators is to help bring your games to life, by giving Bitmagic's AI the FX to truly make your game come alive!

Every sword stroke, every prompt, every breath you take… maybe not that, but with all the games you create, the AI will know what you want and give it to you, just like that!

Explosions, implosions, lighting, water, foliage. The list goes on. Each world you prompt and each game you create will now feel more alive, more responsive and more fun-packed than ever. 

[i]Some of the other work Ari has been doing has been to do with vehicles. [/i]

Some FX are very visual, but some are more subtle, and Ari has been working on making vehicles feel more individual. Through our AI, Bitmagic can now give each vehicle some extra personality through sound and visuals. But not olnly that, Ari is also working on improving the feeling of driving by adding the feeling of weight. A big, heavy truck should feel that way!

[i]Ari, welcome to the team![/i]

[i]Fear not; I will return… with more juicy news![/i]

[b]-JB[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/d7e5c5b8e41f4fd0211a278227064b3b790ebbf2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Vehicles, multiplayer and more to come!
notes.content:
[h3]Big news, small news. News to share throughout the week.[/h3]

[b]Hello hello![/b]

[i]To start, yes, we have been a bit radio silent lately. But there is good reason for that: the team have been working insanely hard on Bitmagic!

Were talking vehicles, FX, physics and a whole host of thoughts for the AI to compute! They are working non-stop, except for their morning coffees, to really make Bitmagic as fantastic… as magic as possible![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/f05b7e25fef42cdc832384c682bf65a2ee3d8fa4.jpg[/img]

[b]So, with some spoilers out of the way, let’s get to some of the news![/b]

Hell yeah, tons of vehicles are now ready and waiting for some bright minds to add to their games.

We got buggies, sports cars, SUVs, Combine Harvesters…yep, trucks, compacts and a whole host of other vehicles. And better than that, they are all drivable, flippable and all-powerful, well some are, the dinky little cars are, dinkey little cars.

While whipping around your game is tons of fun, there is a bit more work to do on vehicles, and a brand-new team member will be adding to the awesome feeling of fast cars. And yes, the dinkey little car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/974844e180059b67e1b9e8f3d9f98f3ea0235ff6.jpg[/img]

[i]I will be back on Thursday with some more update news![/i]

-[b]JB[/b]

notes.title: BITMAGIC COMING TO STEAM!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/52e17e4b3f49cb89dcde50d1f5e82320a1371ae1.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello hello![/b]

So, after a long time with a great [url=https://discord.com/invite/bitmagic]Discord Community[/url] to test the alpha version, Bitmagic has finally hit Steam and will be coming to Beta very soon!

[h3][i]So, I think now is a good time to introduce Bitmagic to you.[/i][/h3]

[previewyoutube=Bz4Ou-k3j3s;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Bitmagic is the world’s first prompt-to-games platform. You don’t need any background in game development to pick up Bitmagic and create. [/b]

[i]The idea is simple: If you have an idea you want to create but don’t know how, don't worry. Now, you can bring that idea to life with Bitmagic simply by typing what game you want and letting Bitmagic create it right before your eyes. 

Bitmagic brings game creation to anyone, whatever language they speak, wherever they are. To build their dream game, creators just need to type in what they want to create… no design skills, coding, or technical knowledge are required. It’s really that simple.

But when Bitmagic created the game, the real fun began; before you share it with others, you can dive into it and shape it to your liking. Games can then be further fine-tuned through further text prompts or shared with other users. The Bitmagic engine creates the game concept, builds the background story and creates an immersive 3D world around the story. The games are fully playable with beautiful graphics and carefully tuned gameplay. [/i]

[url=https://bitmagic.games/]imagine games[/url]

Now I did mention our awesome Discord community. So if you came across us and are not on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/bitmagic][b]Discord[/b][/url], what are you doing. Join us there, it is the place to be to get all the news about Bitmagic. We have behind the scenes videos with the team, discussions about the development and tons of community made levels [b]already[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925853/72d5a9b7b274a7793411be39c50178de873e9dbb.jpg[/img]
